from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,datetime
rows=[]
def run(args):
 p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20);rows.append({'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'argv':args,'exit_code':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr});return p
result={'actions':rows,'dma_idle_proven':False,'sram_reload_completed':False,'session_rebuild_completed':False,'status':'FAIL'}
try:
 boot=Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip();assert boot=='dd39b8d1-cf2d-404e-914d-45eb87278794','Boot changed'
 dev=Path('/sys/bus/pci/devices/0002:21:00.0');assert dev.joinpath('vendor').read_text().strip()=='0x0755' and dev.joinpath('device').read_text().strip()=='0x0755'
 assert dev.resolve().parent.name=='0002:20:00.0'
 method=dev.joinpath('reset_method').read_text().strip();assert method=='bus',method
 own=run(['fuser','-v','/dev/pango_pci_driver']);assert own.returncode==1 and not own.stdout.strip() and not own.stderr.strip(),'Owner/query problem'
 before=run(['setpci','-s',dev.name,'COMMAND']);assert before.returncode==0 and not before.stderr.strip();v=int(before.stdout.strip(),16);assert v==0x0402,'Unexpected Command or Bus Master active'
 result.update(boot_id=boot,endpoint=dev.name,reset_method=method,command_before=hex(v))
 start=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
 with dev.joinpath('reset').open('w') as f:f.write('1\n')
 rows.append({'action':'sysfs_bus_reset','path':str(dev/'reset'),'value':'1','started_utc':start,'completed_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'write_completed':True})
 after=run(['setpci','-s',dev.name,'COMMAND']);assert after.returncode==0 and not after.stderr.strip();new=int(after.stdout.strip(),16);assert new==v,'Command changed across reset'
 result.update(status='BUS_RESET_COMPLETED_BME_DISABLED',command_after=hex(new),driver=str(dev.joinpath('driver').resolve()),reset_completed=True)
 log=run(['dmesg']);result['kernel_tail']=log.stdout.splitlines()[-80:]
except BaseException as e:result['error']=str(e)
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
